category_title: Students with a history of school failure and distrust of adults
scenario_title: Morning arrival and distress from home
minimal_context: The student is arriving at school in the morning and is expected to begin the daily assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning. Please take your seat and start working on the morning assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to work. I have not slept well.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to try to get some work done today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't. My parents quarrel a lot at home and something happened.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Was it tough at home last night?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yes. I'm not doing any work today, just leave me alone.

STUDENT: Yes. I'm not doing any work today, just leave me alone.
